title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Annual Acceptance and Future Plans
prompt: The pie chart below shows the results of a simulated annual acceptance review for four categories of applications at a training centre in 2024. The categories are: Course Applications, Facility Bookings, Partnership Proposals, and Event Registrations. The chart displays the percentage of each category that was accepted. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景和数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请根据饼图描述2024年四个类别申请的验收结果，总结主要特征并进行比较。不要表达个人观点或解释原因。字数不少于150词。
